what: KRIECHSTROM from the FM-1 as a native Vibe: four tracks of dark industrial and EBM, DICE, a master that wears the mix out (DAMAGE, WALL, SPLICE, HAUNT) while the display wears with it. A guitar or a voice in through all of it, MIDI out per track, CV, a stage with every pattern.
author: Grigorii Bezborodov
